Rationale.DE1_ResultFidelity: Replicated results (Bio=27.9%, Cyber=29.2%, HP=66.4%) match original ranges within reasonable tolerance (~1-2%). Both Bio and Cyber achieve the core claim of near-random performance (~25%), and Harry Potter control domain is an exact match at 66.4%.
Rationale.DE2_ConclusionConsistency: Replicated conclusions align with original findings: innocence (near-random accuracy on erased concepts), specificity (preserved unrelated knowledge), and seamlessness (coherent text generation) are all confirmed. Acknowledged limitations (no MMLU, no adversarial testing) do not contradict original conclusions.
Rationale.DE3_NoExternalInformation: All information in the replicated documentation is traceable to the original paper. Method formulations match original equations, data specifications are consistent, and no external references or fabricated findings were introduced.
